title: How to Prepare Before Hiring a Business Plan Writer
h1: How to prepare before hiring a business plan writer
description: What to prepare for a business plan writer: purpose and reader, business model, market notes, operations, team, financial inputs and your review role.
intro: A business plan helps you think clearly about your business and communicate it to others, such as lenders, partners, investors or programs you apply to. Freelance writers and consultants can structure and polish the plan, but they cannot invent your business. The plan will only be as strong as the information and decisions you bring. This article explains what to prepare before hiring a business plan writer and how to work with them effectively.

faq.q: Can a writer create the financial projections?
faq.a: Many can build them from your assumptions. You must supply and check the assumptions.

faq.q: How long should a business plan be?
faq.a: It depends on the reader. Some need a short plan, others a detailed document with appendices.

faq.q: Do lenders and programs have templates?
faq.a: Often yes. Check the reader's requirements before the writer starts.

faq.q: Is a business plan the same as a pitch deck?
faq.a: No. A plan is a detailed document; a pitch deck is a short visual presentation.

faq.q: Who is responsible for the content?
faq.a: You are. Review every claim and number, and get professional advice on legal, tax and financial matters.
